title: Smart India Hackathon Technical Preview
description: Desktop technical preview of the automated IQ & WAV signal analysis engine for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Features offline-first DSP, parameter extraction, and QPSK/FSK modulation classification.
whatsNew: Automatic container format detection for .iq (complex float32/int16) and .wav captures.
Comprehensive parameter extraction: RMS, PAPR, Peak Frequency, Occupied Bandwidth, and Noise Floor.
Scientific explainability framework (Result + Confidence + Evidence + Method).
Real-time DSP visualization engine for FFT spectrum, waterfall, and I/Q constellation.
100% offline-first architecture: zero telemetry, no mandatory cloud sync.
releaseNotes:
### SIGANALYZER v0.9.0 Technical Preview (SIH Milestone)

#### Overview
Initial desktop preview build developed for Smart India Hackathon. Designed to demonstrate automated RF signal characterization, parameter extraction, and modulation classification directly on host hardware.

#### Supported Desktop Operating Systems
- Microsoft Windows 10 & 11 (x64, ARM64)
- Apple macOS 12.0+ (Universal: Apple Silicon & Intel)
- Linux (x86_64, aarch64 glibc 2.31+)

#### Key Capabilities
- Zero-copy streaming ingestion of multi-gigabyte IQ recordings.
- Welch Power Spectral Density and 2D waterfall spectrogram cascade.
- Cyclostationary feature detection for symbol rate recovery.
- Tamper-evident local forensic reporting (HTML / PDF export).
knownIssues: Custom proprietary framing de-interleaving is currently in planned development.
Direct USB SDR streaming hardware capture is in progress; file-based ingestion is active.
